name: Arcane Chantelaine
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item

This ornate clasp has six spectral keys attached to it. As a Magic action, you can touch one of the keys to a closed door, window, gate, container, or hatch to cast the Arcane Lock spell on it. Once a key is used, it disappears. When all six keys have disappeared, the chatelaine disappears.

name: Arcanist's Bestiary
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

Hundreds of pages of illustrations, tables, and diagrams about a wide variety of monsters fill this magical tome.

Charm Monster. While holding the book, you can cast the Charm Monster spell (spell save DC 15) from it. The target has Disadvantage on the saving throw against this spell if it isn't a Humanoid. You can't cast this spell again in this way until the next dawn.

Extensive Knowledge. When you become attuned to the book, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can change your choice. If your Attunement to the book ends, you lose this proficiency.

Monster Primer. While carrying the book, whenever you take a Study action to make an Intelligence (Arcana) check to recall information about an Aberration, Construct, Elemental, Fey, or Monstrosity you can see, on a successful check, you learn whether that creature has any Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities. If the creature has any, you know what they are.

name: Bellows of Strangulation
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item

This bellows has 6 charges. While you are holding it, you can take a Magic action and use one of three command words to cause one of the following effects:

First Command Word. You expend 1 charge to cause the bellows to suck the energy from one creature you can see within 60 feet. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Second Command Word. You expend 3 charges to cause the bellows to suck the energy from creatures in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Incapacitated condition for 1 minute. An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Third Command Word. You expend 5 charges to cast the Cloudkill spell (spell save DC 17) from the bellows.

Regaining Charges. The bellows regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the bellows explodes in a harmless burst of wind and is lost forever.

name: Blood Amulet
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

This delicate amulet looks like a diminutive beating heart impaled with spikes. It has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

Whenever you deal damage to a creature, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra 2d10 Necrotic damage to the target and force it to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains 1 Exhaustion level.

name: Blossom Rod
desc:
Uncommon Rod · Requires Attunement

EVOLVING ITEM.

This rod is made of intertwined, living plant stems.

Budding (Uncommon). Multicolored leaves decorate the rod's stems, and a few buds cluster near each end.

While you hold the rod, you can cast Druidcraft or Plant Growth (Overgrowth only) from it. Once the rod has been used to cast Plant Growth, it can't be used to cast this spell again until the next dawn.

While you hold the rod, as a Magic action, you can rejuvenate nonmagical plants in a 5-foot Cube you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The rejuvenated plants remain verdant for 1d4 days, after which they grow or wither as normal plants would.

Flowering (Rare). Both ends of the rod bear colorful, fragrant flowers. While you hold the rod, you can cast Insect Plague from it, using your spell save DC. When you do so, the insects appear as bumblebees. Once the rod has been used to cast this spell, it can't be used to cast this spell again until the next dawn.

Somniferous (Very Rare). Robust bursts of flowers grow along the rod's length.

While you hold the rod, you can take a Magic action to expel a puff of sleep-inducing pollen in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you. Creatures of your choice in the Emanation must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the Unconscious condition for 1 hour. Creatures that don't sleep, such as elves, or that have Immunity to the Exhaustion condition automatically succeed on the save. The effect ends on a target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to shake it awake. Once the rod has produced this effect, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

name: Boon Companion's Bands
desc:
Uncommon Ring

These rings come in matched pairs bearing identical engravings.

While wearing one of the bands, when you cast a spell or use a feature that forces other creatures in its area of effect to make a saving throw, you can protect the creature wearing the matching band if that creature is in the effect's area. That creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the effect, and it takes no damage if it would normally take half damage on a successful save.

Once this property is used by either band, the bands can't be used again until the next dawn.

If one of the bands in a pair is destroyed, the other one crumbles to dust.

name: Conjurer's Canopy
desc:
Common Wondrous Item

You can take a Magic action and use a command word to plunge this magical walking stick into the ground, where it stands straight up and projects a canopy of transparent force in a 20-foot Cube originating from the stick. The canopy lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a Magic action.

The canopy protects creatures and objects within that area from ordinary weather phenomena such as rain or snow. The atmosphere within the canopy's area is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather. Creatures, objects, and magical effects can still pass through the canopy as usual.

When the canopy disappears, the stick can't be used again for 1d12 hours.

name: Diamond Staff
desc:
Legendary Staff · Requires Attunement

This staff can be wielded as a Magic Quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.

The staff has 20 charges and regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the staff's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff is destroyed.

Adept. You have Advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks.

Dazzling Light. You can expend 1 charge and speak the staff's command word to make it shed Bright Light in a 40-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 40 feet. The light lasts for 1 minute or until you deactivate it.

Spells. While holding the staff, you can cast the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: Detect Magic, Light, and Tongues (0 charges); Identify (1 charge); Knock (2 charges); True Seeing (3 charges); Legend Lore (5 charges); Maze (8 charges).

Stunning Hit. When you hit a creature with the staff, you can expend 2 charges. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of your next turn.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Dictation Quill
desc:
Common Wondrous Item

When you take a Magic action to set this magic quill next to Paper or Parchment and a bottle of Ink and use a command word, the quill writes your next spoken or signed words, in the language you're using, at a rate of 25 words per minute. The quill writes for 1 hour; until it has no Paper, Parchment, or Ink; or until you use another command word to stop it (no action required).

name: Dispelling Ammunition
desc:
Uncommon Weapon (Any Ammunition)

When a target takes damage from this piece of magic ammunition, any ongoing spell of level 3 or lower on the target ends.

Once it hits a target, the ammunition loses its magic properties and becomes ordinary ammunition.

name: Dissuader
desc:
Rare Staff · Requires Attunement

This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. The staff has the following properties; each of them recharges at the next dawn once used.

Calm Emotions. You can cast the Calm Emotions spell (save DC 15) from the staff.

Dissuading Aura. As a Magic action, you create an aura of mental disturbance in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you that lasts for 1 minute. When a creature enters the aura or ends its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn.

Repel. When a creature comes within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to emit a shockwave of force. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 30 feet straight away from you.

name: Dream Weaver
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

This magic tapestry can be hung on a wall or another suitable vertical surface. The tapestry magically unravels and reweaves itself to illustrate the content and emotions of your most recent dreams.

You gain the following benefits while the tapestry is hung and you are within 30 feet of it.

Dream Wisdom. During a Long Rest, you can spend an hour studying the tapestry. At the end of the Long Rest, roll 1d20 and record the number rolled. Once before you finish a Long Rest, you can replace any D20 Test you make with this result. You must choose to do so before you roll the D20 Test.

Message Recorder. If you are targeted by the Dream spell, the tapestry records the appearance and name of the spell's caster in its design.

Mind Wall. While you have the Unconscious condition, you have Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

name: Elocutionist's Lexicon
desc:
Common Wondrous Item

While holding this magic dictionary, you can take a Magic action and try to recall a specific word. The book automatically opens to the page containing the exact word you're searching for.

name: Ensorcelled Missive
desc:
Common Wondrous Item

This item functions as a sheet of Parchment. After writing on it, you can take a Magic action to fold or roll the sheet and seal it while speaking or signing a word or short phrase. If a creature unseals the sheet without using the same word or phrase, the writing on the sheet appears as if it were written in an unknown and unintelligible script.

name: Evergreen Fertilizer
desc:
Common Wondrous Item

Once sprinkled on the soil around a nonmagical plant, this pungent powder keeps the plant healthy for the next 365 days.

name: Goading Ammunition
desc:
Uncommon Weapon (Any Ammunition)

When a creature takes damage from this piece of magic ammunition, it must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn, as it sputters and rages impotently.

Once it hits a target, the ammunition loses its magic properties and becomes ordinary ammunition.

name: Grave Reaper
desc:
Legendary Weapon (Sickle) · Requires Attunement

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a target with it, the target takes an extra 2d8 Necrotic damage.

Soul Lantern. While wielding this weapon, you can cast the Spirit Lantern spell from it (save DC 17). The lantern conjured by the spell can hold up to five soul fragments. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Homeward Compass
desc:
Common Wondrous Item

While holding this small brass compass, you can take a Magic action to orient the compass to your current location. Thereafter, the compass's needle always points toward that location. The compass can be oriented to only one location at a time. As a Magic action, you can end the compass's current orientation. When it isn't oriented to a particular location, or if the compass is on a different plane of existence than the location to which it is oriented, the compass's needle spins aimlessly.

name: Idol of Good Fortunes
desc:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

Evolving magic item. This idol resembles an elephant sitting on its haunches, smiling regally behind its uplifted trunk. An evolved magic item keeps the properties of its previous rarities.

Blemished (Uncommon): the idol is tarnished bronze and slightly damaged. You can cast Augury from it; once used this way, it can't be used again until the next dawn. The idol speaks the omen aloud.

Tarnished (Rare): the idol is gold beneath a patina of dust. While attuned to it you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to transform nonmagical trade bars or gemstones into coinage of equivalent value.

Golden (Very Rare): the idol is polished gold with ruby eyes. You can cast Globe of Invulnerability from it; once used this way, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Keyholes Dagger
desc:
Uncommon Weapon (Dagger)

Evolving magic item. The hilt of this magic weapon is adorned with ornate, decorative keyholes outlined in golden filigree. An evolved magic item keeps the properties of its previous rarities, though attack and damage bonuses do not stack.

Three Keyholes (Uncommon): you have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you take the Attack action, you can transform this weapon into a Handaxe or a Mace; it stays transformed until the start of your next turn, when it reverts to its Dagger form. You can use Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls made with it.

Ten Keyholes (Rare): the bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls becomes +2, and the weapon can transform into any Simple Melee weapon.

Many Keyholes (Very Rare): the bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls becomes +3, and the weapon can also transform into a Battleaxe, Longsword, Rapier, Scimitar, or Warhammer. In addition, when you miss with an attack roll made with this weapon, you can reroll the attack roll and must use the new roll. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Lucky Foot
desc:
Common Wondrous Item

When you roll a 1 on a saving throw or ability check, you can use this preserved rabbit foot's magic to reroll the die. You must use the new roll, and the foot disintegrates.

name: Mage Breaker
desc:
Rare Weapon

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

When you hit a concentrating creature with an attack roll using this weapon and deal damage, the creature has Disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration.

name: Mage's Manacle
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item

As a Magic action while wearing this bracelet, you can target a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the Grappled or Incapacitated condition. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or become magically bound to you by a spectral chain and manacle that spring from the bracelet.

While bound in this way, the creature has the Restrained condition. When you move, the creature moves with you.

A creature remains bound for 8 hours or until you release it (no action required). If the manacle takes damage from a Disintegrate spell, it is destroyed; nothing else can break or harm it. Once the manacle has bound a creature, it can't be used again this way until the next dawn.

name: Magewright's Gloves
desc:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

While you wear these gloves, you work as efficiently as two characters when determining how much time it takes to craft nonmagical items with Alchemist's Supplies, Brewer's Supplies, Calligrapher's Supplies, Cartographer's Tools, Glassblower's Tools, or Jeweler's Tools.

name: Martialist's Quarterstaff
desc:
Uncommon Weapon (Quarterstaff)

This magic quarterstaff has 4 charges and regains 1d4 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can expend charges for the following properties.

Searing Smite: you can expend 2 charges to cast the Searing Smite spell (save DC 13) from the staff.

Throw: when you take the Attack action, you can expend 1 charge to infuse the staff with magical velocity. Until the end of your next turn, the staff gains the Thrown property (range 20/60 feet), and it returns to your hand immediately after you make a ranged attack with it.

Trip: when you make a melee attack with the staff, you can expend 1 charge to gain Advantage on the attack roll. On a hit, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have the Prone condition.

name: Namer's Needle
desc:
Rare Weapon

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Identify Target. When you hit a creature with an attack roll using this weapon, you can compel the target to reveal its identity. The target makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target says or signs its name clearly and emphatically. On a successful save, the target is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. If the creature can't speak or sign a language, it automatically succeeds on the save.

Named Target. When you hit a creature with an attack roll using this weapon, you can say or sign the target's name clearly and emphatically to turn the hit into a Critical Hit. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Necklace of the Beastly Familiar
desc:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

This necklace comes with a matching charm for your familiar.

Find Familiar: you can cast the Find Familiar spell from the necklace. Once the necklace has been used to cast this spell, it can't be used to cast it again until the next dawn.

Beastly Familiar: while your familiar is within 60 feet of you, you can take a Magic action to transform it into the Beast form determined by the necklace's gemstone for 10 minutes. While transformed, the familiar keeps its alignment, personality, creature type, Hit Points, and Hit Dice, and it gains a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to the Hit Point maximum of the Beast form. The transformation ends early if those Temporary Hit Points are reduced to 0.

Gemstone and Beast form:
- Azurite (Uncommon): Giant Octopus
- Chrysoprase (Rare): Giant Scorpion
- Zircon (Rare): Hippopotamus
- Topaz (Very Rare): Mammoth
- Fire Opal (Legendary): Tyrannosaurus Rex

name: Orb of Divination Detection
desc:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

This glass orb reacts to scrying and other prying magic.

When you are targeted by a spell from the Divination school, the orb glows bright green for the duration of that spell.

You can use the orb as an Arcane Focus.

name: Orb of Sorcery
desc:
Uncommon Wondrous Item

Ribbons of varicolored light swirl inside this glass orb.

While holding the orb, you can take a Magic action to regain up to 2 expended Sorcery Points. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

You can use the orb as a Spellcasting Focus for your Sorcerer spells.

name: Potion of Dragon's Breath
desc:
Uncommon Potion

When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Dragon's Breath spell for 1 minute (save DC 13, no Concentration required). The damage type of the breath corresponds to the potion's color: Black (Acid), Blue (Lightning), Green (Poison), Red (Fire), or White (Cold).

The glittery liquid inside this potion is made from the pulverized scale of a chromatic dragon.

name: Potion of Tirelessness
desc:
Uncommon Potion

After you drink this potion, for the next 24 hours you don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. In addition, you can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a state of quiet focus, during which you retain consciousness.

This pale red potion is as thick as molasses, yet it slides out of the bottle as readily as oil.

name: Prismatic Rune
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

A magical rune is etched on this small stone made of multicolored quartz. When you finish a Long Rest, choose one of the following damage types: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. The rune is imbued with the chosen damage type until you finish another Long Rest.

The rune has 6 charges and regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can expend 1 charge to change the spell's damage type to the damage type chosen for the rune.

name: Queen Ehlissa's Marvelous Nightingale
desc:
Artifact Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

A mechanical songbird with crystal eyes, golden feathers, and a small windup key on its back, named for its first owner, a queen of the eastern Flanaess in the world of Greyhawk.

Activation. As a Magic action you can cause the bird to spring to life for 10 minutes, during which it sings a melody audible out to 300 feet, or revert it to its mechanical form. Once the nightingale becomes mechanical again, it can't come to life again for 1 hour.

Charges. The nightingale has 6 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn.

Ensemble Casting. While the nightingale sings, you can take a Bonus Action to cast one of the following spells from it (spell save DC 18), expending the listed number of charges: Calm Emotions (1 charge), Slow (2 charges), Compulsion (3 charges), Greater Restoration (4 charges), Delayed Blast Fireball (6 charges), Prismatic Spray (6 charges). Detect Evil and Good and Speak with Animals can be cast from it for 0 charges.

Aura of Truth. While the nightingale sings, the effect of a Zone of Truth spell (save DC 18) fills a 15-foot Emanation originating from the nightingale. While attuned to the nightingale, you know which creatures succeed on or fail the saving throw against this effect.

Counterspell. While the nightingale sings, you can take a Reaction to cast Counterspell (save DC 18) in response to that spell's trigger. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Random Properties. The artifact has the following random properties (see the "Artifacts" section of the Dungeon Master's Guide): 2 minor beneficial properties, 1 major beneficial property, 1 minor detrimental property.

Destroying the Nightingale. The nightingale is destroyed if it is released into a whirlwind in Limbo.

[Note: text reconstructed from a community wiki transcription and corroborating preview coverage; wording is mechanically faithful but not a verbatim copy of the book.]

name: Ring of Dedicated Focus
desc:
Uncommon Ring · Requires Attunement

When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can roll up to two of your unexpended Hit Dice and add the total rolled to your save, potentially turning the failure into a success. The rolled Hit Dice are then expended.

name: Scholar's Anchoring Bangle
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

This heavy magical bracelet inures your mind against potential distractions. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits.

Deep Knowledge. When you take the Study action and make an Intelligence check using a skill in which you have proficiency, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

Single-Minded Focus. When you fail a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration, you can take a Reaction to succeed instead. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Secret Keeper's Circlet
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

While wearing this circlet, you can take a Magic action to specify a trigger, such as "after I leave this temple" or "when I cast the Animate Dead spell." For the next 24 hours, if that trigger occurs, the circlet erases your memory of everything that happened from the moment you set the trigger until the moment it activated. The lost memories can't be restored by any magic short of a Wish spell.

Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Spell Component Ring
desc:
Common Ring

This steel ring has a discreet chamber lined with a mystical inscription. As a Magic action, choose one spell you have prepared that requires a Material component; the required Material component must neither have a cost specified nor be consumed by the spell. You store that spell's Material component in the ring's chamber.

Whenever you cast the chosen spell, you don't need to have a hand free to access its Material component, provided you are wearing the ring. The ring can hold the Material component for one spell at a time.

name: Spell Duelist's Trophy
desc:
Rare Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

This trophy is a withered hand or talon fixed to a leather cord, worn as a necklace or a bracelet. It has the following properties.

Dispelling Touch. When you hit a creature with a melee spell attack, you can activate the trophy to cast the Dispel Magic spell as part of that attack, targeting the creature you hit. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

Helping Hand. When you cast a spell using a spell slot, you can cast it without any Somatic components.

Mage Hand. You can cast the Mage Hand cantrip from the trophy.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Spell-Slinger's Puppet
desc:
Uncommon Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

As a Bonus Action while holding this ventriloquist's doll, you can pull the cord on the doll's back to cause the doll to levitate to an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of yourself and hover there. While the doll hovers, you can take a Bonus Action to cause the doll to move up to 30 feet to another unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The doll hovers for 1 minute or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action.

While the doll is within 30 feet of you, you can speak using the doll's mouth rather than your own. This allows you to, for instance, cast a spell with a Verbal component even if you can't speak.

name: Staff of Skulls
desc:
Uncommon Staff · Requires Attunement

Evolving magic item with three tiers.

Ominous (Uncommon). A skull adorns the top of the staff. While you hold the staff, you can cast Chill Touch from it, using your spell attack bonus. You also have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks while holding the staff, and the skull's eye sockets glow, shedding Dim Light in a 5-foot radius.

Chattering (Rare). Several skulls fused together adorn the top of the staff. When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on that roll, as the skulls' eyes glow green and their teeth chatter unnervingly.

Pulverizing (Very Rare). The entire staff is made of fused skulls. While you hold the staff, you can take a Magic action to point the staff at a Humanoid you can see. The target makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 10d8 Necrotic damage and has the Prone condition. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Staff of the Lost
desc:
Very Rare Staff · Requires Attunement

This staff can be wielded as a Magic Quarterstaff that grants a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.

The staff has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Maze (save DC 18) or Teleport from it. When the staff has no charges remaining, it loses its magic and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

Curse. This staff is cursed, and attuning to it extends the curse to you. You are unwilling to part with the staff and keep it on your person. In addition, you never know which way is north, and you have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to navigate.

Whenever you expend a charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, 1d4 Minotaurs of Baphomet materialize, each appearing in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you. The minotaurs begin combat with you immediately.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Sweeping Broom
desc:
Common Wondrous Item

As a Magic action, you can use this unassuming broom's command word, choosing a point you can see on the ground within 60 feet of yourself. The broom animates and sweeps dust and detritus from the ground in a 20-foot square centered on the chosen point. It sweeps that area until you take another Magic action to deactivate it.

name: Thespian's Playbill
desc:
Uncommon Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

While holding this magical theater program, whenever you take the Study action and make an Intelligence check, you gain a bonus to the check equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1).

name: Thief's Thimble
desc:
Uncommon Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

While wearing this thimble, if you trigger a trap and take damage, the thimble takes the damage instead. The thimble has 30 Hit Points. If the thimble is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it breaks, and you take any remaining damage.

name: Tramontane Armor
desc:
Very Rare Armor (Any Light or Medium) · Requires Attunement

This armor is enchanted to look like a scholarly or priestly robe. You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class while wearing it. It has the following properties.

Mountain Walker. Difficult Terrain composed of heavy snow, ice, rubble, or undergrowth doesn't cost you extra movement.

Grasping Tendrils. You can take a Magic action to activate the armor, causing its hems to extend into ribbon-like tendrils. While the armor is active, you can take a Bonus Action to force each creature you choose within 20 feet of you to make a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) and is pulled up to 20 feet toward you. The armor remains active for 1 minute, until you take a Magic action to deactivate it. Once activated, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Traveler's Pearl
desc:
Legendary Wondrous Item · Requires Attunement

By using a command word while holding this pearl, you can cast the Teleport spell from it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

(This is the item's only property. Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Universal Pantograph
desc:
Artifact Wondrous Item

A cubical box measuring 2 feet on each side, apparently made of oak bound with silver and decorated with engravings of marionettes and laughing children.

Duplication. If a nonmagical item is placed inside the box and the lid is closed, an identical duplicate of that item is produced.

Cloning. As an action you can cause the box to enlarge until it is big enough for a Medium creature to sit inside. While a creature is inside the closed box, sprinkling it with diamond dust worth 100+ GP casts the Clone spell on that creature. The duplicate grows over 120 days while the pantograph remains sealed. The clone created this way doesn't need to be contained within a vessel and endures indefinitely while inert.

Destroying the Pantograph. The pantograph can be destroyed only by being submerged in a bog in the Feywild for 999 years, and only if it doesn't currently contain a clone.

Note: this item is a 5.5e update of the AD&D artifact Halavar's Universal Pantograph (Book of Artifacts, Netheril: Empire of Magic). No attunement requirement and no Random Properties section were reported by the sources consulted.

[Note: text reconstructed from a community wiki transcription and corroborating preview coverage; wording is mechanically faithful but not a verbatim copy of the book.]

name: Wand of Freshness
desc:
Uncommon Wand

This wand has 4 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast the Purify Food and Drink spell from it.

name: Wand of Slumber
desc:
Rare Wand · Requires Attunement

This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend charges to cast one of the following spells from it (save DC 15): Catnap (3 charges) or Sleep (1 charge).

The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand is destroyed.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Wand of Teeth
desc:
Rare Wand

This wand has 10 charges. While holding it, you can take a Magic action and expend up to 3 charges to spray spectral teeth in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. Roll one d8 for each charge you expended. On a failed save, a creature takes Piercing damage equal to the total rolled and has the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

The wand regains 1d10 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand breaks apart into harmless splinters and is destroyed.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)

name: Wave-Swept Weapon
desc:
Uncommon Weapon · Requires Attunement

This weapon is covered in oceanic motifs, from wavelike etchings on its blade to stylized sea monsters embroidered onto its leather hilt. Evolving magic item with three tiers.

Barnacled (Uncommon). You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While holding this weapon, you can take a Magic action to touch up to a gallon of liquid and infuse it with brine.

Aquatic (Rare). The wavelike etchings on this weapon's blade glow with light, shedding Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet. The bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls increases to +2. While you hold the weapon, you can breathe underwater, and you have a Swim Speed of 30 feet.

Ascendant (Very Rare). The embroidery on the hilt is studded with gemstones. The bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls increases to +3. While you hold this weapon, you have a Fly Speed of 30 feet; when you use this Fly Speed, a salty sea breeze carries you through the air.

name: Workshop Wrecker
desc:
Very Rare Wondrous Item

This 3-inch metal sphere can be activated with a Magic action. It remains active for 1 minute or until you speak its command word while within 30 feet of it.

When you activate the ball and at the beginning of each of your turns while the ball is active, each creature in the enclosed area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking Bludgeoning damage on a failed save. The save DC and the damage depend on the size of the space containing the ball:

- 15-foot Cube: DC 18, 6d6 + 5 Bludgeoning damage
- 30-foot Cube: DC 17, 4d6 + 4 Bludgeoning damage
- 50-foot Cube: DC 15, 2d6 + 2 Bludgeoning damage
- 100-foot Cube: DC 14, 1d6 + 1 Bludgeoning damage

Nonmagical objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried also take this damage. In spaces larger than a 100-foot Cube, the damage is negligible. If the ball is activated in an unconfined space, it flies 300 feet per round in a random direction.

Once activated, this item can't be activated again until the next dawn.

(Not an evolving/growing item — single fixed rarity.)
